description: R-WIRE fixture r-wire-param: table W as in r-wire-blank, then every cell of r-wire-dao written through a temporary QueryDef per column, PARAMETERS pI Long, pV <column's parameter type>; INSERT INTO W (ID, column) VALUES (pI, pV), with Parameters("pI").Value and Parameters("pV").Value = Arg and QueryDef.Execute. Cells: FByte (IDs from 100): ui1-0, ui1-255, i2-256, i2-minus1, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FInt (IDs from 200): i2-min, i2-max, i4-32768, i4-minus32769, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FLong (IDs from 300): i4-min, i4-max, r8-2147483648, r8-minus2147483649, r8-0.5, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FSingle (IDs from 400): plus-zero, minus-zero, min-subnormal, max-subnormal, min-normal, max-finite, plus-inf, minus-inf, qnan, qnan-payload, snan, negative-qnan, r8-1e39, r8-1e-50, r8-0.1; FDouble (IDs from 500): plus-zero, minus-zero, min-subnormal, max-subnormal, min-normal, max-finite, plus-inf, minus-inf, qnan, qnan-payload, snan, negative-qnan, one-plus-ulp, r4-0.1-widened, r8-0.1; FCurr (IDs from 600): cy-min, cy-max, cy-0.0001, cy-minus-0.0001, r8-0.00005, r8-0.00015, r8-1e15, bstr-5-decimals; FDate (IDs from 700): oa-0, oa-min, oa-max, below-min, above-max, negative-1.5, negative-0.25, positive-1.5, one-millisecond, half-second, nan, plus-inf, r8-tag-1.5, bstr-iso; FText (IDs from 800): empty, ascii, bmp, nul-middle, nul-only, astral, lone-high, lone-low, reversed-pair, u-fffe, odd-1-byte, odd-3-bytes, odd-3-bytes-high, len-255, len-256; FMemo (IDs from 900): empty, nul-middle, lone-high, lone-low, odd-1-byte, odd-5-bytes, len-300, len-5000, astral-4000, odd-8001-bytes; FBin (IDs from 1000): empty, leading-zeros, all-zero, ramp-255, ramp-256, bstr-ab, bstr-odd-3-bytes, hex-literal; FOle (IDs from 1100): empty, leading-zeros, ramp-256, pattern-5000, bstr-ab, bstr-odd-3-bytes; FBool (IDs from 1200): true, false, i2-1, i2-2, i2-minus1, r8-0.5, bstr-True, bstr-0, ui1-255; FDec (IDs from 1300): bstr-1.5, bstr-minus-0.0001, bstr-14.4-digits, bstr-28-digits, bstr-29-digits-max, bstr-trailing-zero, bstr-negative-zero, cy-1.5, r8-0.1, i4-7. Created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); every call's result and error is recorded and the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE W (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_W PRIMARY KEY, FByte BYTE, FInt SHORT, FLong LONG, FSingle SINGLE, FDouble DOUBLE, FCurr CURRENCY, FDate DATETIME, FText TEXT(255), FMemo MEMO, FBin BINARY(255), FOle LONGBINARY, FBool YESNO)
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Byte; INSERT INTO W (ID, FByte) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Short; INSERT INTO W (ID, FInt) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Long; INSERT INTO W (ID, FLong) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV IEEESingle; INSERT INTO W (ID, FSingle) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV IEEEDouble; INSERT INTO W (ID, FDouble) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Currency; INSERT INTO W (ID, FCurr) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV DateTime; INSERT INTO W (ID, FDate) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Text(255); INSERT INTO W (ID, FText) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV LongText; INSERT INTO W (ID, FMemo) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Binary; INSERT INTO W (ID, FBin) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV LongBinary; INSERT INTO W (ID, FOle) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Bit; INSERT INTO W (ID, FBool) VALUES (pI, pV);
PARAMETERS pI Long, pV Decimal; INSERT INTO W (ID, FDec) VALUES (pI, pV);
